data.one_liner: Native Android and iOS camera wrapper for taking pictures and scanning barcodes.
data.what_it_does: Provides camera preview, picture capturing, and barcode scanning capabilities utilizing native Camera2 API, AVFoundation, and MLFirebase. Includes an easy-to-use controller for flash control, pausing, and resuming.
use_when: You need a quick solution to capture photos and scan barcodes within a Flutter app.
You want automatic camera permission and resource handling without third-party plugins.
avoid_when: You need advanced custom camera pipeline manipulation or complex video recording features.
You prefer pure Dart implementations without native view embeddings.
strengths: Automatic permission and camera resource lifecycle management
Supports both picture taking and barcode scanning
Configurable scale types (fill and fit) and flash modes
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding custom error handling
Specific native API settings (like API_X vs API_2) have distinct feature trade-offs
data.setup_notes: iOS requires adding io.flutter.embedded_views_preview and Privacy - Camera Usage Description in info.plist.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: A well-maintained dedicated alternative specifically focused on fast barcode and QR code scanning.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: The official camera plugin providing deeper control over the device camera preview, image streams, and recording.

data.minimal_example:
cameraKitController = CameraKitController();
cameraKitView = CameraKitView(
  cameraKitController: cameraKitController,
  hasBarcodeReader: true,
  barcodeFormat: BarcodeFormats.FORMAT_ALL_FORMATS,
  scaleType: ScaleTypeMode.fill,
  previewFlashMode: CameraFlashMode.auto,
  androidCameraMode: AndroidCameraMode.API_X,
  cameraSelector: CameraSelector.back,
  onPermissionDenied: () {},
  onBarcodeRead: (code) {},
);
